phases.name: Owner
phases.goal: Decisions, accounts and people only the owner can provide.

phases.name: Setup
phases.goal: An empty app that builds, tests and deploys a preview on every pull request.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Sign-in, 18+ sign-up, roles, app shells, account and consent, with access rules proven by tests.

phases.name: Library
phases.goal: Boxing, S&C and Gym lessons people can browse, search, save and complete, with author, review and publish.

phases.name: Training
phases.goal: Coaches build and share programs; athletes train, log and see progress; coaches see logs and give feedback.

phases.name: Marketplace
phases.goal: Athletes find, compare, hire and pay coaches; coaches earn; reviews are verified.

phases.name: AI guide
phases.goal: Cited, safe answers from published lessons, with a daily limit and a passing eval set.

phases.name: Launch
phases.goal: Launch in steps: an 18+ invite beta, an open beta after the lawyer, then the marketplace (decision-m6-launch).

tasks.title: Razorpay Subscriptions
